rationale: MEASURED (scala3 corpus, 300-file sample): qualified PascalCase calls obj.Method() are enum-case/module member accesses (LoadDestination.Jump, tpd.This), NOT constructions - 1156 occurrences would all fabricate Instantiates edges. The companion-apply heuristic must apply to receiver-less calls only; qualified PascalCase emits Calls. Bare Type(...) constructions remain Instantiates. NOTE: the call must be a real call_expression (obj.Method(args)), not a bare field access chain (dest.Jump.check() only calls the LAST segment).
